messages:
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary health check FAILED for release `payments-eu` in eu-central-1. Observed pod eviction spike + values hash mismatch on overlay `overlays/eu`. Auto-hold applied.

maria: saw this alert. can someone grab logs? looks like evictions started right after canary patch.

leo: grabbing pod logs now, but stacktrace shows OOMKilled on worker and kubelet eviction reason: 
```
Killing process 4123 (python) total-vm:1023456kB, anon-rss:785432kB, file-rss:1200kB
Reason: NodeAllocatableEnforced
```

aj: quick suspicion: overlay `replicaCount` and `resources.requests.memory` changed in the newer chart bump. overlay-merges earlier this week might have accidentally reduced memory. can we diff the applied values?

maria: run `helm get values payments-eu --namespace eu -o yaml` and compare to `git show origin/main:overlays/eu/values.yaml` — doing now.

sam: if it's confirmed, we have two options: 1) hotpatch the values (increase memory/replica) and re-run canary, or 2) pin the chart version the deploy-bot holds to the last-known-good chart and re-run canary with that version while we fix the overlay merge strategy.

aj: prefer pin + fix. hotpatch is noisy and might mask the root cause of overlay collision. also we need a quick release-note line so CS knows what happened.

leo: diff command I used: `git --no-pager diff --no-index -- overlays/eu/values.yaml <(helm get values payments-eu -n eu -o yaml)` — shows `replicaCount: 2 -> 1` and `resources.requests.memory: 1024Mi -> 512Mi`.

maria: ok. consensus: annotate/hold + pin chart to previous working version (3.4.1) and re-run canary. aj, can you cut the pin and open a PR for the overlay merge fix?

aj: on it. pin command I'll run now: 
```
helm upgrade payments ./charts/payments --namespace eu --version 3.4.1 --reuse-values --set-string "release.redwood/pinned=true"
```

deploy-bot: Hold annotation added to release `payments-eu` by maria. Canary re-run blocked. Notifying release leads.

sam: release_notes: "payments(eu): temporarily pinned to payments-chart@3.4.1 after canary evictions caused by overlay values drift (replicaCount/resources). Investigating overlay merge conflict. Will roll forward with fix."

maria: filing follow-up ticket: RD-2345 - payments overlay merge collision: investigate why overlay patch reduced memory/replicas. assigning to @aj. Target: fix + test in staging before next window.

aj: ack. I'll repro locally with `helm template` + `kubeval` and send a values-merge strategy PR today. aiming to remove pin by EOD tomorrow if tests pass.

leo: quick check commands for the team: `kubectl describe pod <pod>` and `kubectl top node` to confirm node pressure; also `git diff --overlays` helper shows last merge author.

sre-bot: FYI: scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 03:00 UTC. If pin remains beyond that, we should coordinate a rollback/maintenance change.

maria: noted. I'll update the release calendar and add the release-note line to the changelog draft.

sam: :thumbsup:

maria: final call for now: pin applied, hold in place, follow-up ticket created, PR expected from aj. re-open thread when canary green or if we need to rollback older revision.

leo: thanks — will monitor logs and post metrics if anything spikes further.
